findings.description: The cache is a single map shared by every vhost. With a small `cache_bytes`, filling it from `Host: beta.test` evicts the alpha exec entry, and the next alpha client re-executes instead of being served the cached page. Reproduced on all five cache builds with `cache_bytes=260` and six fill pages.
findings.title: One global cache map across Host, so a beta-vhost fill evicts an alpha exec entry

limitations: All RCE is RCE on the upstream host
Needs a cache-enabled config and an upstream that sends Cache-Control: public, max-age=
